text: The Team plan costs $49 per seat per month.
evidence: pricing/plans-2026.md: Team: $39 per seat per month billed annually, or $45 per seat billed monthly.
note: Team is $39 billed annually or $45 billed monthly; $49 is the Business price.

text: Annual billing on the Team plan is cheaper than paying monthly.
evidence: pricing/plans-2026.md: Team: $39 per seat per month billed annually, or $45 per seat billed monthly.
note: $39 per seat billed annually is less than $45 per seat billed monthly.

text: Kenji Mori approved the 2027 price increase a few days ago.
note: Kenji is only recorded as drafting the 2027 pricing proposal for the board; no approval is recorded, and drafting does not rule one out.

text: Self-serve signup currently requires a credit card.
evidence: decisions/product-decision-log.md: 2026-09-01 — Self-serve signup no longer asks for a credit card.
note: The 2026-05-06 credit-card requirement was reversed on 2026-09-01.

text: Route optimization v2 is enabled for all Enterprise customers.
evidence: notes/2026-09-29-launch-sync.md: Route optimization v2 stays disabled by default for Enterprise accounts and is switched on per account when the customer asks.
note: Disabled by default for Enterprise and switched on per account on request (two accounts in flags.json).

text: Route optimization v2 cut average route time by 12%.
note: The 12% in the evidence is the pilot's cut in dispatcher planning time, not route time.

text: Pilot customers will probably get route optimization v2 for free.
note: Pilot pricing 'has not been decided'; that leaves the claim open rather than contradicting it.

text: Driver tipping is turned on only for US drivers.
note: The tipping flag is enabled with US as its only region; Canada still waits on legal sign-off.

text: The customer ETA widget was approved at the 2026-08-21 roadmap review.
evidence: notes/2026-08-21-roadmap-review.md: Customer ETA widget: shelved until the tracking SDK rewrite lands.
note: The widget was shelved at that review; the item approved there was the dispatcher console.

text: Offline mode was cut from the 4.0 mobile release.
evidence: notes/2026-09-29-launch-sync.md: Offline mode is out of scope for 4.0 and moves to 4.2.
note: Out of scope for 4.0 and moved to 4.2; the next claim restates the same fact in other words.

text: Mobile 4.0 will not include offline mode.
evidence: notes/2026-09-29-launch-sync.md: Offline mode is out of scope for 4.0 and moves to 4.2.
note: Same fact as the previous claim; its negation agrees with the evidence.

text: The Android app requires Android 11 or later.
note: Only the iOS minimum (iOS 16) is given; for Android the notes say no change is planned without naming the current minimum.

text: 2026-02-10: we decided to sunset the legacy CSV importer.
evidence: decisions/product-decision-log.md: 2026-02-10 — Sunset the legacy CSV importer by 2026-06-30.
note: The dated decision was made; the later postponement does not undo that it was made on 2026-02-10.

text: The legacy CSV importer was shut down at the end of June 2026.
evidence: decisions/product-decision-log.md: 2026-06-24 — CSV importer sunset postponed indefinitely: 14% of active accounts still import with it every week.
note: The 2026-06-30 sunset was postponed indefinitely on 2026-06-24.

text: The CSV importer sunset was postponed because the new importer was not ready.
note: The postponement is recorded, but its stated reason is continued use by 14% of accounts; nothing is said about the new importer's readiness.

text: Customers can no longer export routes as KML.
evidence: release-notes/3.8.md: KML export is unchanged and remains available on every plan.
note: KML export remains available; 3.8 removed GPX export, not KML.

text: GPX files can no longer be exported.
evidence: release-notes/3.8.md: GPX export was removed from the web app and the mobile apps.
note: 3.8 removed GPX export, and gpx_export is disabled in flags.json.
